title: ising3d continuous supervisor: plan turn output
description: One bounded exact-research task proposed by a planner/producer-author turn. The independent verifier is authored in a separate fresh review turn, so this object names no verifier script (seed plan files may add a 'verifier' object with the review-schema shape).

decision.description: 'run' executes producer then independent verifier; 'stop' halts the supervisor safely (stop_reason required).

front.description: norm = characteristic-zero norm envelope (rank 1); wlaw = W-law defect blocks (rank 2); callen = Callen contact quotient (rank 3); other = another explicit ranked-queue item (front_rank and front_label required).

hypothesis_id.description: New row appended this turn to notes/hypotheses.csv; must exceed the highest existing id.

next_prompt.description: Context-rich statement of the bounded task, its falsifiable predictions, and its exact scope limits, written for the fresh review turn and the next planner.

artifact.description: Target-relative JSON path under results/ that the producer creates (must not exist yet) or, when producer is null, an existing artifact to verify.

verifier_requirements.description: What an independent verifier must recompute or check, including exact digests/degrees/counts it must reproduce and the scope it must not exceed.

artifact_expect.description: Dotted paths into the artifact document (e.g. 'data.scope', 'data.columns.1.column_sha256') with the exact expected scalar; the supervisor checks each after the producer run.

checkpoint_evidence.description: Brief citations of the checkpoint lines/rows that justify this task.

source_changes.description: Target-relative files created or edited during this turn.
